defects.description: renderLine quotes a field that contains a comma but never doubles an embedded double quote, so the rendered line is not RFC 4180 and cannot round-trip.
defects.why_missed: Happy-path fields contain letters or a comma but never a quote, so the quote branch is never exercised and branch coverage of renderLine is already complete without it.

defects.description: parseLine splits on every comma before considering quotes, so a quoted field that contains a comma is split into two broken fields.
defects.why_missed: The suite only quotes fields without commas, and the correct handling has no branch to reach: the defect is the absence of a quote-aware scanner, invisible to coverage.
